segments.normalizedSource: ```swift // Create a new session with the first and last entries from a previous session. func newContextualSession(with originalSession: LanguageModelSession) -> LanguageModelSession { let allEntries = originalSession.transcript // Collect the entries to keep from the original session. let entries = [allEntries.first, allEntries.last].compactMap { $0 } let transcript = Transcript(entries: entries) // Create a new session with the result and preload the session resources. var session = LanguageModelSession(transcript: transcript) session.prewarm() return session } ```
